name: Muqarna
description: Muqarnas: tiers of little niches stepping out from the wall as the vault turns a corner.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 4%; width: 92%; height: 52%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0; -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 28%, transparent 28% 34%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 28%, transparent 28% 34%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 58%; width: 92%; height: 38%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0; -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 20%, transparent 20% 24%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 20%, transparent 20% 24%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
